# Urban GIS Lab

> Practical GIS for understanding and planning cities. Educational site for the English-language Udemy course Urban Spatial Analysis & Modeling with ArcGIS Pro, taught by Masoud Ebadi.

## Site

- Homepage / course landing: https://urbangispro.github.io/
- Primary language: English
- Publisher: Urban GIS Lab
- Instructor: Masoud Ebadi

## Course (external)

- Title: Urban Spatial Analysis & Modeling with ArcGIS Pro
- Platform: Udemy
- URL: https://www.udemy.com/course/urban-spatial-analysis-with-arcgis-pro/?referralCode=64855D6258A9CB243BD7
- Language: English
- Size: 9 sections, 56 lectures, 16 hours 13 minutes
- Includes: 16 hours on-demand video, 1 article, 14 downloadable resources, lifetime access, certificate of completion
- Requirements: ArcGIS Pro installed; basic urban planning or geography helpful but not mandatory; no programming required

## Topics covered in the course

- Building coverage ratio (BCR), floor area ratio (FAR), population density
- Urban form, risk zones, kernel density
- Distance analysis, zonal statistics, reclassification, service coverage
- Spatial site selection and suitability modeling
- Transportation networks, optimal routing, OpenStreetMap networks
- Service areas, nearest facilities, origin-destination matrices, gravity modeling
- Location-allocation for population coverage
- Spatial statistics: Average Nearest Neighbor, Moran’s I, Hot Spot Analysis, clustering, outliers
- Urban growth simulation, Time Slider, temporal analysis
- 2D/3D population density (hexagonal grids), sun shadow and street-level sunlight

## Free tutorials on this site

- Population density analysis in ArcGIS Pro: https://urbangispro.github.io/population-density-analysis-arcgis-pro/
- Urban accessibility analysis using GIS / ArcGIS Pro: https://urbangispro.github.io/urban-accessibility-analysis-arcgis-pro/
